# Litmatch context pack

> Machine-readable context for the Litmatch social voice app (NestJS core-api, signaling-gateway, LiveKit, Next.js web, Vite admin). Many small files with stable ids; static analysis only; code wins over docs.

## Start here

- [README](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/README.md): id scheme and task routing
- [Module index](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/modules/index.md): 25 modules with counts and links
- [Flows index](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/flows/index.md): 72 cross-service flows
- [Issue ledger](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/issues/index.md): problems met while building
- [Manifest](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/index.json): every entity id with file and related ids

## Human-readable pages (large, not for crawling)

- [System Atlas](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/index.html), [Service Map](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-service-map/), [Error History](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/)

## service-map

- [service-map:admin](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/admin.md): API back-office: RBAC, audit, điều phối module
- [techniques:admin](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/admin-techniques.md): 17 technique cards.
- [service-map:app-shell](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/app-shell.md): Health probe và hợp đồng capabilities
- [techniques:app-shell](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/app-shell-techniques.md): 7 technique cards.
- [service-map:auth](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/auth.md): Đăng nhập, phiên refresh và nâng cấp guest
- [techniques:auth](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/auth-techniques.md): 23 technique cards.
- [service-map:avatar](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/avatar.md): Catalog, sở hữu và trang bị avatar
- [techniques:avatar](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/avatar-techniques.md): 9 technique cards.
- [service-map:calling](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/calling.md): Vòng đời CallSession voice 2 người trên LiveKit
- [techniques:calling](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/calling-techniques.md): 19 technique cards.
